collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager who has not swum in the sea since a frightening current is called in by a friend: paddle, or stay on the sand.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Long ago, (subject) was caught by a strong current and pulled out past the rocks before someone reached (subject.him/her). (subject.He/she) was fine. (subject.He/she) hasn't swum in the sea since. Everyone knows, and nobody mentions it. Today it's hot, and everyone is swimming, and (friend) calls from the water, "Come in! It's lovely!"

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) walks down to the edge and lets the water wash over (subject.his/her) feet. That's all. It's cool and nice. (subject.He/she) stays there, ankle-deep, for a long time. (friend) swims over and sits in the shallows next to (subject.him/her). They talk. (subject) doesn't go any further. (subject.He/she) doesn't need to.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Not today," says (subject), and stays on the sand under a tree. (friend) waves and swims on. (subject) watches everyone splashing. Some part of (subject.him/her) misses it. Another part of (subject.him/her) is very glad to be on dry land. (subject.He/she) is allowed both. (subject.He/she) may swim again someday. Or not.
